data.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
desc: As an action, distract nearby foes so your allies have advantage against them until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Pack Tactics
desc: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature when an ally is within 5 feet of it and not incapacitated.

data.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks while you or the target is in direct sunlight.

data.name: Bite
desc: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage using Strength.

data.name: Cunning Artisan
desc: During a short rest you can harvest suitable remains to craft simple bone, hide, or shell equipment.

data.name: Hold Breath
desc: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes.

data.name: Hunter's Lore
desc: Choose two skills from Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth, and Survival; you are proficient in them.

data.name: Natural Armor
desc: While you are not wearing armor, your AC is 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.

data.name: Hungry Jaws
desc: As a bonus action, make a special bite attack; on a hit you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1.
